name: What are common signs of a leaking pipe in my home?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a leaking pipe in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a leaking pipe include unexpected increases in your water bill, visible water stains on walls or ceilings, peeling paint or wallpaper, a musty odor, or the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use. You might also notice damp spots on floors or carpets, or a decrease in water pressure. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent further damage to your property.
